body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 643d0d06af1f8c4ea1e962c83f196f9b9681b3b5 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- Interior tessellation edges and vertices are filtered at the source: `is_feature_edge` (`feature_graph.rs`) keeps only edges between two different welded faces, bends past 40 degrees, open boundaries and non-manifold folds. Sliver/zero-area facets are ignored via `has_area`. Feature points come only from feature-edge vertices, so a vertex inside a face or a chord vertex of a smooth wall is never a point. Pinned by `flat_face_triangulation_edges_are_not_pickable`, `cylinder_facet_edges_are_not_pickable_but_its_rim_is`, `a_box_corner_is_a_point_but_a_vertex_inside_a_face_is_not`.
- Visible-first: edge/point/centre candidates are occlusion-tested (`occluded`, `feature_pick.rs`) against every non-stock body from the eye (perspective) or along the view line (ortho), with a length-scaled tolerance; `through` is the only bypass. Faces come from the front-most hit, so cannot pick through. Perspective and ortho both pinned.
- Degenerate input: no `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` in the three new modules; indexing is via `.get()`; non-finite origin/dir/radius and zero-length rays return `None`; NaN-safe `cos_between`, `total_cmp` sorts. `degenerate_input_picks_nothing_and_never_panics` covers it.
- Layering: app layer only, no ui/egui deps; reuses `geometry::feature` and `model::features_of_local` rather than a second weld; no new components. Provenance headers present, files under 400 lines, decision file in `docs/decisions/`, no snapshot PNG or CHANGELOG edits, body has `Changelog: none` and `Refs #692`.

**Local results (merged with upstream/main; merge was clean, no conflicts)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test feature_pick` | 7/7 pass |
| `--test pick` | 9 pass |
| `--test vertex_pick` | 4 pass |
| `--test feature` | 18 pass |
| `--lib pick` | 2 pass |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --lib --test feature_pick -- -D warnings` | clean |

Test binaries were built individually (known #686 break in `lathe_thread_travel` not touched). UI not built (no UI change).

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
- `pick_bodies` is O(candidates x triangles) for occlusion, tested only for tier winners until one passes; fine for step 1, worth a profile on large meshes once step 2 calls it per frame.
- `PickBody::new` caches graphs thread-locally (cap 8); with many large bodies in a scene the cache could thrash per frame. Worth watching in step 2.
- Commit type is `feat`, so it merges at the next cut per AGENTS.md.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
